issue.title: Fix issue
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create a big number chart with a `SUM(sales)` metric.
2. Enable `Show trend line`.

Expected behavior: the trend line renders under the number.
Actual behavior: the chart renders blank and the network response contains the expected data.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/plugins/plugin-chart-echarts/src/BigNumber/`.
Acceptance criteria: the trend line renders and the BigNumber plugin tests pass.
